subject: political-science

source.qualification: Pearson Edexcel Level 3 Advanced GCE in Politics (9PL0)
source.document: Specification — Issue 4 (updated May 2026; first teaching September 2017)
source.track: GCE A level · ages 16–18 · three written papers; Component 3 offers a choice of Government and Politics of the USA (3A) or Global Politics (3B)

note: Units follow the specification's numbered content areas in teaching order, grouped by the three components; the two Component 3 units cover the option paper, of which students study either 3A or 3B. Core political ideas (liberalism, conservatism, socialism) share one atlas lesson because the specification teaches them through the same three-part structure of core ideas, tensions and key thinkers.
